subject: maths
question: P, Q and R, when working individually, can complete a job in, respectively, 36 days, 48 days and 144 days. P, Q and R start working together. P leaves the job 12 days before completion and Q leaves the job 8 days before completion. R works from the beginning till the end of the job. Determine the total number of days taken to complete the job.
solution:
**Given:**

P alone can do a job in 36 days.

Q alone can do a job in 48 days.

R alone can do a job in 144 days.

P leaves before 12 days of completion.

Q leaves before 8 days of completion.

R works from start to end.

**Concept used:**

Efficiency = Total work/Required time

**Calculations:**

Total work = LCM of (36, 48, 144) = 144 units

Let, the job be completed in X days.

According to the question,

4 × (X - 12) + 3 × (X - 8) + 1 × X = 144

⇒ 4X - 48 + 3X - 24 + X = 144

⇒ 8x = 144 + 48 + 24

⇒ 8x = 216

⇒ X = 27

**∴ The total number of days taken to complete the job is 27 days.**
